answer.reason: The verses tell two events of Gad's story beyond the summary: his warning to David to leave the hold, and his message to David after the census, with the command to build an altar.

clauses.english: told David to leave the hold and go into the land of Judah
clauses.quote: Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah.

clauses.english: brought David the LORD's choice of three punishments for numbering the people
clauses.quote: I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them

clauses.english: told David to build an altar to the LORD on the threshingfloor of Araunah
clauses.quote: Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

doubts: 2CH 29:25 only mentions Gad's commandment about the Levites' instruments, so it was left out as a minor detail.
1CH 29:29 only mentions a book of Gad, so it was left out.
